newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says NAB MD to join board.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says NAB MD to join board.

text.p: Australia's largest company, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP), said on Wednesday that Don Argus, managing director of National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), had agreed to join the board of directors.

"Mr Argus will bring to the board wide experience in international business, a very strong management background and an outstanding career in the finance industry," BHP chairman Brian Loton said in a statement.
Argus, who has been managing director of the nation's most profitable bank since 1990, will join the BHP board from November 30. -- Melbourne bureau 61-3 9286-1435
